checks.name: flow
checks.cmd: node examples/flow.mjs
expect: [prefix] https://app.example/callback/../logout?next=https://attacker.example → 受理 https://app.example/logout
[exact] https://app.example/callback/../logout?next=https://attacker.example → invalid_request（redirect_uri 不一致）
[wildcard https://*.app.example/callback] https://attacker.example/.app.example/callback → 受理 https://attacker.example/.app.example/callback
[state検証=false PKCE=false] → ログイン成立：セッション victim-session が attacker として扱われる
[state検証=false PKCE=true] → トークン取得に失敗：invalid_grant（code_verifier 不一致）
[state検証=true PKCE=false] → state 不一致で拒否
[state検証=true PKCE=false] → ログイン成立：セッション attacker-session が victim として扱われる
[state検証=true PKCE=true] → トークン取得に失敗：invalid_grant（code_verifier 不一致）
[パブリッククライアント PKCE=false] 攻撃者が /token を直接呼ぶ → access_token 発行
[パブリッククライアント PKCE=true] 攻撃者が /token を直接呼ぶ → invalid_grant（code_verifier 不一致）
[ダウングレード対策=false] → ログイン成立：セッション victim-session が attacker として扱われる
[ダウングレード対策=true] → トークン取得に失敗：invalid_grant（PKCE ダウングレード）
[PKCE 必須] → 認可リクエストで拒否：invalid_request（code_challenge が無い）
同じ code で 2 回目 → invalid_grant（code 再利用。発行済みトークンを失効）
1 回目の access_token → 失効
redirect_uri を /callback2 に変えて交換 → invalid_grant（redirect_uri が認可リクエストと違う）
[iss検証=false] → トークン取得に失敗：invalid_grant。攻撃者の認可サーバに届いた code 1 個
[iss検証=true] → iss 不一致で拒否（code を送らない）。攻撃者の認可サーバに届いた code 0 個

checks.name: rfc-fragment
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "Additionally, implicit grants" "The attack utilizes the fact"
expect: Additionally, implicit grants (and also other grants when using response_mode=fragment as defined in [OAuth.Responses]) can be subject to a further kind of attack.
The attack utilizes the fact that user agents reattach fragments to the destination URL of a redirect if the location header does not contain a fragment (see Section 17.11 of [RFC9110]).

checks.name: rfc-iss-missing
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9207.txt "Clients MUST reject authorization responses without"
expect: Clients MUST reject authorization responses without the iss parameter from authorization servers that do support the parameter according to the client's configuration.

checks.name: rfc-guess
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc6749.txt "The probability of an attacker guessing"
expect: The probability of an attacker guessing generated tokens (and other credentials not intended for handling by end-users) MUST be less than or equal to 2^(-128) and SHOULD be less than or equal to 2^(-160).

checks.name: rfc-unauthorized-client
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc6749.txt "The client is not authorized to request an access"
expect: The client is not authorized to request an access token using this method.

checks.name: rfc-redirect
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "When comparing client redirection URIs" "Clients and authorization servers MUST NOT expose URLs"
expect: authorization servers MUST utilize exact string matching except for port numbers in localhost redirection URIs of native apps
(open redirectors)

checks.name: zenn-wildcard
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/zenn/02-insufficient-redirect-uri-validation.txt "認可サーバーは、ワイルドカード"
expect: 「/ を含む任意の文字列」として解釈する不適切なパターンマッチ

checks.name: rfc-loopback
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc8252.txt "The authorization server MUST allow any port"
expect: The authorization server MUST allow any port to be specified at the time of the request for loopback IP redirect URIs

checks.name: rfc-csrf
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "Clients that have ensured" "In OpenID Connect flows, the nonce" "Otherwise, one-time use CSRF"
expect: MAY rely on the CSRF protection provided by PKCE.
In OpenID Connect flows, the nonce parameter provides CSRF protection.
one-time use CSRF tokens carried in the state parameter that are securely bound to the user agent MUST be used

checks.name: zenn-session
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/zenn/07-csrf.txt "本記事における「セッション」とは" "あらかじめ Session Fixation"
expect: 攻撃者による推測や改竄ができない、セキュアに管理された状態を指します。
あらかじめ Session Fixation 攻撃などへの対策が講じられていることが前提となります。

checks.name: rfc-injection
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "From the attacker's device" "In the response of the authorization server to the legitimate client" "Asymmetric methods for client authentication" "Public clients MUST use PKCE" "For confidential clients, the use of PKCE"
expect: From the attacker's device, the attacker starts a regular OAuth authorization process with the legitimate client.
the attacker replaces the newly created authorization code with the stolen authorization code.
Asymmetric methods for client authentication do not stop this attack, as the legitimate client authenticates at the token endpoint.
Public clients MUST use PKCE
For confidential clients, the use of PKCE [RFC7636] is RECOMMENDED

checks.name: rfc-public
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "It is important to note that nonce does not protect" "Instead, an attacker can directly call"
expect: It is important to note that nonce does not protect authorization codes of public clients, as an attacker does not need to execute an authorization code injection attack.
Instead, an attacker can directly call the token endpoint with the stolen authorization code.

checks.name: rfc-nonce
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "If an attacker injects an authorization code in the authorization response"
expect: the nonce value in the client session and the nonce value in the ID Token received from the token endpoint will not match, and the attack is detected.

checks.name: rfc-s256
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "Currently, S256 is the only such method"
expect: Currently, S256 is the only such method.

checks.name: rfc-downgrade
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "The first prerequisite for this attack" "The second prerequisite for this attack" "Using state properly would prevent this attack" "However, practice has shown" "Authorization servers MUST mitigate PKCE downgrade"
expect: The first prerequisite for this attack is that there is an attacker-controllable flag in the authorization request that enables or disables PKCE for the particular flow.
The second prerequisite for this attack is that the client is not using state at all (e.g., because the client relies on PKCE for CSRF prevention) or that the client is not checking state correctly.
Using state properly would prevent this attack.
However, practice has shown that many OAuth clients do not use or check state properly.
a token request containing a code_verifier parameter is accepted only if a code_challenge parameter was present in the authorization request

checks.name: rfc-code-reuse
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc6749.txt "If an authorization code is used more than once" "parameter is present if the"
expect: the authorization server MUST deny the request and SHOULD revoke (when possible) all tokens previously issued based on that authorization code.
if included ensure that their values are identical.

checks.name: rfc-referer
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "The page rendered as a result of the OAuth authorization response"
expect: SHOULD NOT include third-party resources or links to external sites.

checks.name: zenn-referer
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/zenn/03-credential-leakage-via-referer-headers.txt "主要なモダンブラウザでデフォルト" "攻撃者が S_VIC を取得できてしまうと"
expect: 主要なモダンブラウザでデフォルトとなっている strict-origin-when-cross-origin では、cross-origin のリクエスト内の Referer ヘッダーに参照元 URL のパスやクエリは含まれないため、本攻撃は成立しない点に注意してください。
攻撃者が S_VIC を取得できてしまうと、state による CSRF 保護は失われ、攻撃者は CSRF を実行できる可能性があります。

checks.name: rfc-history
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "Clients MUST NOT pass access tokens in a URI query"
expect: Clients MUST NOT pass access tokens in a URI query parameter in the way described in Section 2.3 of [RFC6750].

checks.name: zenn-samesite
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/zenn/04-credential-leakage-via-browser-history.txt "コールバック処理が SameSite=Lax"
expect: コールバック処理が SameSite=Lax のセッション Cookie に依存している場合、その Cookie はこの POST では送信されず、ユーザーのセッションを復元できないために state の検証などに失敗する可能性があります。

checks.name: rfc-mixup
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "When an OAuth client can interact"
expect: a defense against mix-up attacks (see Section 4.4) is REQUIRED.

checks.name: rfc-iss
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9207.txt "If the value does not match the expected"
expect: clients MUST reject the authorization response and MUST NOT proceed with the authorization grant.

checks.name: zenn-mixup
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/zenn/11-mixup-attack.txt "攻撃者が H-AS に悪意のあるクライアント"
expect: 攻撃者が H-AS に悪意のあるクライアント (クライアント ID = CID_EVIL) を登録し、そのクライアントが https://client.example.com/cb/a-as をリダイレクト URI として使用する場合、本対抗策は突破されてしまいます。

checks.name: rfc-implicit
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc10017.txt "Browser-based clients MUST use the Authorization"
expect: Browser-based clients MUST use the Authorization Code grant type and MUST NOT use the Implicit grant type to obtain access tokens.

checks.name: rfc-at-injection
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "Since the response includes the state value" "There is no way to detect such an injection" "In OpenID Connect, the attack can be mitigated"
expect: the client does not treat the response as a CSRF attack and uses the access token injected by the attacker.
There is no way to detect such an injection attack in pure-OAuth flows
the authorization response additionally contains an ID Token containing the at_hash claim.

checks.name: oidc-at-hash
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/oidc-core-1_0.txt "The value of at_hash in the ID Token MUST"
expect: The value of at_hash in the ID Token MUST match the value produced in the previous step.

checks.name: oidc-idtoken
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/oidc-core-1_0.txt "Clients MUST validate the ID Token in the Token Response" "The Issuer Identifier for the OpenID Provider" "The Client MUST validate that the aud" "If the ID Token is received via direct" "The Client MUST validate the signature of all other ID Tokens" "The current time MUST be before" "If a nonce value was sent in the Authentication Request"
expect: Clients MUST validate the ID Token in the Token Response
MUST exactly match the value of the iss (issuer) Claim.
The Client MUST validate that the aud (audience) Claim contains its client_id value
the TLS server validation MAY be used to validate the issuer in place of checking the token signature.
The Client MUST validate the signature of all other ID Tokens according to JWS
The current time MUST be before the time represented by the exp Claim.
a nonce Claim MUST be present and its value checked

checks.name: rfc-nonce-once
checks.cmd: node examples/rfc-quote.mjs sources/rfc9700.txt "The nonce value is one-time use"
expect: The nonce value is one-time use and is created by the client.
